summary:
Comprehensive EasyUI-inspired Design System implementation plan for TailorFit:
1. CSS variables for Light and Dark themes, system preference detection with toggle.
2. Motion tokens module (lib/motion-tokens.ts) with calm spring physics and prefers-reduced-motion support.
3. Hand-built UI components in components/ui/ (Button, MorphingSaveButton, SegmentedControl, SpringSelect, Input/Textarea, AnimatedFileUpload, AnimatedNumberMorph, DrawCheckbox, Toasts, SmallFloatingDock, ExpandableDataRow, ThemeToggle, NotificationDropdown).
4. Restyle screens (Overview, Clients, Settings) and Navbar with monochrome neutral surfaces, hairline borders, Geist Mono tabular numerals, origin-anchored popovers, and SettleModal mobile sheets.
5. Responsive rules with desktop 3-col, tablet 2-col + collapsible bottom section, mobile floating dock single-panel view, and pinch-zoom enabled viewport.
